bio.short: Data Engineer and AI Solutions Engineer with a Master of Science in AI. I build end-to-end data systems and practical AI applications: RAG pipelines, LLM fine-tuning, data quality platforms and dashboards.
story: My journey started in civil engineering, but I discovered my passion for data and AI during my time at G&P Geotechnic, where I automated engineering workflows and built data solutions. That spark led me to become a Certified Data Analyst and pursue a Master's in Artificial Intelligence, and I haven't looked back since.

Now as a Data Engineer at AEM Energy Solutions, I build AI infrastructure and data platforms for the energy sector: an in-house LLM framework and APIs, a Data Quality Platform that became the enterprise standard, and pipelines that turn engineering PDFs into searchable vectors. Before this, at EISmartwork, I built prediction models on datasets of over 10 million records and dashboards that cut report generation time in half.

I hold a Master of Science in AI from UMPSA with a CGPA of 3.76, and certifications from Microsoft, Google Cloud, Anthropic and IBM. In 2025 I spoke as a Google Speaker at AI Build, made the Top 20 of AWS National and of the Cursor x Anthropic Hackathon, and won the Innovation Challenge at the Axiata Digital Leadership Programme.

What drives me? Turning messy data into clear insights, building systems that learn and improve, and staying ahead in the fast-moving world of AI. Whether it's designing data workflows, training smart models, or creating visual dashboards, I'm passionate about solving tough problems that make a real difference.
